content.title: How Long Is The Super Mario Galaxy Movie?
content.text: With The Super Mario Galaxy Movie's release date in theaters quickly approaching, fans are craving as many details as they can get about the animated film.How to WatchNow that we know the release date and which fan-favorite celebrities are voicing the characters, it's time to get into the nitty-gritty, like how long The Super Mario Galaxy Movie is going to be.Keep reading for more details.What is The Super Mario Galaxy Movie's runtime?Officially, The Super Mario Galaxy Movie clocks in at 1 hour, 38 minutes.RELATED: Everything to Know About The Super Mario Galaxy MovieIn other words, that's 98 minutes of your favorite Nintendo characters embarking on their biggest adventure yet — and more Super Mario Easter eggs than you can shake a Goomba at. It doesn't matter if you're a new fan or grew up playing Super Mario Bros. in your local arcade in the '80s: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie is a can't-miss film for all ages.The film's predecessor, The Super Mario Bros. Movie (2023), has a run time of 1 hour, 32 minutes When does The Super Mario Galaxy Movie come out?Mario, Luigi, Princess Peach, and the rest of the heroes return for an intergalactic adventure of a lifetime on Wednesday, April 1, 2026, when The Super Mario Galaxy Movie hits theaters. RELATED: The Voice of Yoshi Has Been Revealed for The Super Mario Galaxy Movie As the Final Trailer DropsThe film's release date was actually moved up a few days to match the Wednesday premiere day of The Super Mario Bros. Movie in 2023.Who voices the characters in the new Super Mario movie?The sequel stars Chris Pratt as Mario, Anya Taylor-Joy as Princess Peach, Charlie Day as Luigi, Jack Black as Bowser, Keegan-Michael Key as Toad, Benny Safdie as Bowser Jr., Kevin Michael Richardson as Kamek, and Brie Larson as Rosalina. RELATED: See the Super Mario Galaxy Movie Trailer & Learn All About the CharactersTalk about an all-star cast.RELATED: Chris Pratt's Unconventional Ways of Getting Coins To Play Mario Arcade Games As a KidLarson shocked the world with her November 2025 reveal that she would be voicing Rosalina, calling the news "an absolute dream come true."The Super Mario Galaxy Movie will be brought to life by the same team behind the first movie, with Chris Meledandri of Illumination and Shigeru Miyamoto of Nintendo serving as producers. The sequel also shares the same directors (Aaron Horvath and Michael Jelenic), screenwriter (Matthew Fogel), and composer (Brian Tyler). How to watch the first Super Mario Bros. Movie (2023)Mario and Luigi's first big-screen adventure is currently streaming on Peacock!
